item.title: Projects
item.description:
My Projects

Here are some of the projects I’ve been working on. You can find more on my GitHub.

Textile Production Planning System

A microservices-based system to help textile manufacturers plan and control factory production.

Tech: Node.js, MongoDB, React.js

Outsourced Manufacturer Audit App

An application to audit and manage outsourced manufacturers for quality control.

Tech: Node.js, MongoDB, React.js

Hotel Proposal Generation System

A system supporting a hotel’s sales team in generating and sending priced proposal orders to clients.
